chapters.text: The company's debit and credit cards: pick which card paid an expense and see spending per card.
Open Finance → Cards and press Add card: name (e.g. Meezan Visa), last 4 digits, debit or credit, who holds it, the money holder it spends from and an optional monthly limit.
When adding an expense, choose Paid with card.
Each card shows this month's spending (a bar against its limit, red when over), how many expenses and the total so far.
See expenses opens Entries filtered to that card. Switch off a card that's no longer used; its old expenses stay.
